tools.name: upcoming
tools.description:
START HERE. Earnings calls with mention markets in the next N days: entity, venues, word count, top3 word:p

:n. <=4.8 KB a week.

tools.name: brief
tools.description: One call, a row per listed word: settled n/y/rate/l10, transcript th/tn, p. By event, appearance, or entity(+date). <=3.2 KB; offset pages the rest.

tools.name: word
tools.description: Will <entity> say <word>? One line: settled history, transcript history, p, scope, next listing. next=true: the next market's word. <=480 bytes.

tools.name: quotes
tools.description: Where a word was said: <=25-word quotes, speaker, section, counted under the market's scope. ~250 bytes/row.

tools.name: clips
tools.description: Timed audio clips of a word, mp3:<source>@<a>-<b> (~175 timed past calls; no new clips are added). ~200 bytes/row.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Settlement history of an entity's words (most settled first); with word, every settled listing of it. offset pages.

tools.name: receipts
tools.description: Settled markets: frozen p vs price at listing, T-24h, T-1h; head scores both; offset pages.

tools.name: screen
tools.description: Every open market, a row each with p and the book; filter, sort vol|date|p. <=4 KB; offset pages.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search companies, executives and call transcripts ('yesterday' works). JSON results [{id,title,url,text}]; ids work with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One document by id (entity, appearance, k:/p: event, <entity>/words/<word>, or a URL) as JSON.

tools.name: entity
tools.description: Entity card: kind, hub, tier, venues, next / last call, top words. <=1.6 KB.

tools.name: changes
tools.description: What changed since an ISO time or a next cursor (ts type id op); strikes roll up into their event.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: Earnings calls (id, date, quarter, words, flags), newest first.

tools.name: get_qa
tools.description: Settled strikes where our count disagrees with the result (JSON).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
